From there it runs across the land, topping off rivers and lakes and trickling down into the aquifers underground. The whole loop keeps shuffling fresh water around the planet, which is what keeps both ecosystems and people going. Trouble is, the stuff we do, plus a warming climate, can throw these rhythms off and tip places into drought or flooding. So the water cycle's one of nature's quiet workhorses, and it's a neat little picture of how every piece of the Earth's system hangs together.

It generates gnarly random passwords, locks them in a vault, and you only have to remember one master password. Mine also warns me when a site I use gets breached, which is handy. I get the hesitation, putting every password in one place feels like a giant target, what if it gets cracked? Fair worry.
